generator.params.bloom_area.note: The leaf area its `bloom` look draws on an organ 1 m long (visual forms Skill 1, 2026-10-14; plantc atlas), so it shades with what it shows: the look now takes its card from the taxa's characters, where before it drew the generic card (-).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), as Simmondsia chinensis: leaves 2 cm to 4 cm long.

generator.params.spur_leaf.note: A short shoot's leaf card, a little smaller than a long shoot's (leaf_size), within Abrams vol. 3 (1951): leaves 2 to 4 cm long.

generator.params.leaf_size.note: Leaf card length, petiole included, sized so every leaf drawn stays within Abrams vol. 3 (1951): leaves 2 to 4 cm long (0.06 drew them 5.4 to 5.9 cm).

traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), as Simmondsia chinensis: grows 1 m to 2.5 m tall.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Simmondsia chinensis (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.63 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 2 records in 2 sources); trunks 0.63, branches 0.59. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

generator.params.path_half.note: A choice of the model's (crown form step B, broadleaf revision 11): the wood from the base at which a shoot's nodes are half as long, fitted so the plant grows to the height of its oldest reference size, with the crown's width left to grow inside the loose region.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a dense, rounded evergreen shrub 1 to 2 m tall with stiff, leathery, oblong grey-green leaves in opposite pairs held nearly upright, edge to the midday sun. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 1.1 m at 10 years and 1.6 m at 40. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: dull grey-green leaves.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Simmondsia chapter (read in full): the flowers are borne in the axils of the leaves.

traits.self_pruning.note: FEIS's jojoba review (page read): as the plant ages its lower foliage is shaded out and pruned, leaving a high canopy.

traits.sexual_system.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 368, 370, Simmondsia chinensis: sexual system dioecious.
